en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing an early 20th‑century boulevard with tram tracks running down the center, several vintage automobiles and a bus, lined with neoclassical villas and palm trees. Low mountains rise in the background. Handwritten caption at the bottom identifies the location as a boulevard between Kifissia and Athens. A modern printed URL appears on the right side of the image.
